- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed pros of separate appraisal: tailored expertise, detailed attention, personalized documentation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed cons of separate appraisal: additional cost, time and effort.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed pros of appraising together: convenience, cost-effective, comprehensive report.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Listed cons of appraising together: less specialized attention, less detailed documentation.
